struct@(A,B) Pair {
  x: Int@A;
  y: Int@B;
}

func@(A,B,C) foo() {
  let pair: [Pair@(A,B)] = [Pair@(A,B) { x: 10, y: 20 }];

  let i = 0@A;
  let x: Int@A = pair[i].x; // valid since `i` and `x` both at `A`

  if true@B {
    let y: Int@B = pair[0].y; // valid since `y` at `B` which is in scope
  }
}
---
(source-file
  (struct
    (role-type
      (role A)
      (role B)) Pair
    (struct-body
      (struct-field x
        (named-type Int@
          (role-type
            (role A))))
      (struct-field y
        (named-type Int@
          (role-type
            (role B))))))
  (func
    (func-sig
      (role-type
        (role A)
        (role B)
        (role C)) foo
      (params))
    (scope "{"
      (let pair
        (type
          (list-type
            (named-type Pair@
              (role-type
                (role A)
                (role B))) "]"))
        (list
          (struct-expr Pair@
            (role-type
              (role A)
              (role B))
            (field-init x
              (int 10))
            (field-init y
              (int 20)) "}") "]") ";")
      (let i
        (int 0)@
        (role-type
          (role A)) ";")
      (let x
        (type
          (named-type Int@
            (role-type
              (role A))))
        (field
          (index pair i "]") x) ";")
      (if
        (bool true)@
        (role-type
          (role B))
        (scope "{"
          (let y
            (type
              (named-type Int@
                (role-type
                  (role B))))
            (field
              (index pair
                (int 0) "]") y) ";") "}")) "}")))
